sa: अश्रौषीस्त्वं राजधर्मान् यथा वै मनुरब्रवीत्। क्रूरान् निकृतिसम्पन्नान् विहितानशमात्मकान्॥ धार्तराष्ट्रान् महाराज क्षमसे किं दुरात्मनः। कर्तव्ये पुरुषव्याघ्र किमास्से पीठसर्पवत्॥ बुद्ध्या वीर्येण संयुक्तः श्रुतेनाभिजनेन च।
en: You have heard the duties of kings told by Manu, they are fraught with crookedness and unfairness, they are perfectly opposed to peace and virtue. O great king, why do you then forgive the wicked-minded of Dhritarashtra. O foremost of men, why are you silent in performing your duties being a man of ' high birth?

sa: वृद्धान् बन्दी वादविदो निगृह्य वादे भग्नानप्रतिशङ्कमानः। जले सर्वान् मज्जयतीति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that the learned Bandi, after defeating (in controversy), men who are experts in discussion, causes them to be drowned by faithful servants employed by you.

sa: ज्ञानवृद्धं च वृद्धं च भूयांसं केशवं मम। अजानत इवाख्यासि संस्तुवन् कौरवाधम॥
en: Owretch of the Kuru race, wishing to praise Keshava (Krishna), you describe him before me as great and superior in knowledge and age, as if I know nothing.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच सुरासुरैरवध्यं तदहं ज्ञात्वा विशाम्पते। अब्रुवं मातलिं हृष्टो याह्येतत् पुरमञ्जसा॥
en: Arjuna said: O lord of earth, learning that they were indestructible by the gods and Asuras. I gladly said to Matali "do you go to this city speedily.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रयान्तं कौन्तेयं ब्राह्मणा वनवासिनः। अभिगम्य तदा राजन्निदं वचनमबृदन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O king, thereupon those dwellers of the forest, those Brahmanas, seeing that the son of Kunti was about to, came to him and spoke these words.

sa: ततो गतेषु देवेषु कलिपरमब्रवीत्। संहर्तुं नोत्सहे कोपं नले वत्स्यामि द्वापर॥ भ्रंशयिष्यामि तं राज्यान्न भैम्या सह रंस्यते। त्वमप्यक्षान् समाविश्य साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: After the celestials had disappeared, Kali said to Dvapara, 'O Dvapara, I cannot restrain my wrath, I will enter into the Nala and disposes him of his kingdom. He shall not any longer hold any dalliance with the daughter of Bhima. Placing yourself at the dice, you ought to help me.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच उपस्तीर्णा सभा राजन् सर्वे त्वयि कृतक्षणाः। अक्षानुप्त्वा देवनस्य समयोऽस्तु युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Shakuni said O king, the Assembly is full. All was waiting for you. O Yudhishthira, let now the dice be cast and the rules of play be fixed.

sa: मे वैशम्पायन उवाच विज्ञाय तं बलोन्मत्तं बाहुवीर्येण दर्पितम्। हृदयेनावहस्यैनं हनूमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Knowing him to be intoxicated and proud of his strength of arms. Hanuman slighted him (very much) in his mind and he thus spoke to him.

sa: अवध्यान् पाण्डवान् प्राहुर्देवपुत्रान् द्विजातयः। अहं वै शरणं प्राप्तान् वर्तमानो यथाबलम्॥ गन्ता सर्वात्मना भक्त्या धार्तराष्ट्रान् सराजकान्। नोत्सहेयं परित्यक्तुं दैवं हि बलवत्तरम्॥
en: Drona said The Brahmanas have said that the Pandavas of celestial origin are incapable of being killed. The sons of Dhritarashtra, with all their forces, heartily and with reverence have sought my protection; I shall look after them to the best of my power. I cannot abandon them. Destiny is Supreme.

sa: यौवनस्थामपि च तां शीलाचारसमन्विताम्। न वव्रे पुरुषः कश्चिद् भयात् तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: When she grew youthful, even then for the fear of the illustrious king none dared ask for her hand, endued as she was with good and excellent manners.

sa: न चार्थो भैक्ष्यचर्येण नापि क्लैब्येन कर्हिचित्। वेत्तुं शक्यः सदा राजन् केवलंधर्मबुद्धिना॥
en: But wealth cannot be acquired by leading the life of a mendicant nor by bearing a life of weakness. O king, wealth can be earned by virtuous intelligence.

sa: अयुक्तामात्मनः पूजां त्वं पुनर्बहु मन्यसे। हविषः प्राप्य निष्यन्दं प्राशिता श्वेव निर्जने॥
en: You (surely) think much of the worship so unworthy of freed to you, as a dog (joyfully) licks in solitude a quantity of Ghee which he has obtained.

sa: वाच्यावाच्ये हि कुपितो न प्रजानाति कर्हिचित्। नाकार्यमस्ति क्रुद्धस्य नावाच्यं विद्यते तथा॥
en: The angry man cannot distinguish what should be and should not be said by him; there is nothing which cannot be said or done by an angry man.

sa: कालो दुर्योधनं हन्तुं सानुबन्धमरिंदम। एकाचां पृथिवीं सर्वां पुरा राजन् करोति सः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, this is the (proper) time to kill Duryodhana with all his attendants. Otherwise, O prince, he will bring the whole world under his subjection.

sa: सैनिकान् मम सूतं च हयांश्च समवाकिरत्। अचिन्तयन्तस्तु शरान् वयं युध्याम भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he showered arrows on my soldiers, on my charioteer and on my horses. But without much caring for his arrows, we continued to fight.

sa: अहो ममोपरि विधेः संरम्भो दारुणो महान्। नानुबध्नाति कुशलं कस्येदं कर्मणः फलम्॥
en: 'Oh! the god's anger is violent and great upon me; and hence it is that peace never follows me. Of what deed (or misdeed) is this the result?

sa: मनो ह्यदुष्टं शौचाय पर्याप्तं वै नराधिप। मैत्री बुद्धिं समास्थाय शुद्धास्तीर्थानि द्रक्ष्यथ॥
en: O ruler of men, the mind which is free from all evil thoughts is highly pure. Therefore bearing friendly feelings towards all the purifying yourselves, visit the Tirthas.

sa: प्रतिजग्राह तत् कृष्णः शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा। शिशुपालस्तु तां पूजां वासुदेवे न चक्षमे॥
en: Krishna also (agreed to) accept that worship according to the forms of the ordinance. But Shishupala could not bear that worship (proposed to be) offered to Vasudeva (Krishna),

sa: विद्वांस्तथैव यः शक्तः क्लिश्यमानो न कुप्यति। अनाशयित्वा क्लेष्टारं परलोके च नन्दति॥
en: And the wise man too, who though oppressed does not allow his anger to be excited, rejoices in the next world for having treated his persecutor with indifference.

sa: मन्योर्हि विजयं कृष्णे प्रशंसन्तीह साधवः। क्षमावतो जयो नित्यं साधोरिह सतां मतम्॥
en: The pious always praise him, O Krishna (Draupadi), who has conquered his anger; it is held by the pious that the honest and forgiving man is always victorious.

sa: तेन संस्पृष्टगात्रस्य भीमसेनस्य वै तदा। संज्ञा मुमोह सहसा वरदानेन तस्य हि॥
en: And in consequence of the boon which the serpent had received, as soon as Bhimasena's body came in contact with that of the serpent, he lost his senses.

sa: शतं वर्षसहस्राणि मुने जातस्य तेऽनघ। समाख्याहि मम ब्रह्मन् किं दुःखं चिरजीविनाम्॥
en: Indra said: O Rishi, O sinless one, you have lived for one hundred thousand years. O Brahmana, tell me what are the sorrows of those who live forever.

sa: उन्मत्तां विलपन्ती मां भार्यामिष्टां नराधिप। ईप्सितामीप्सितोऽसि त्वं किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे॥
en: O ruler of men! wherefore do you not answer me, your dear wife, raft of reason and bewailing you, although you love her and are loved in return?

sa: अभिप्रायं तु विज्ञाय महिष्याः पुरुषर्षभः। प्रियायाः प्रियकामः स प्रायाद् भीमो महाबलः॥
en: Knowing the desire of their queen (Draupadi), that foremost of men, the greatly strong Bhima, set out, so that he might gratify the desire of the beloved one.

sa: एतज्ज्ञात्वा समागच्छ ततो मां नय सूतज। ज्ञात्वा चिकीर्षितमहं राज्ञो यास्यामि दुःखिता॥
en: Ascertaining. this, O son of Suta, come here and then take me with you. Knowing the desire of the king (Yudhisthira), I shall go with a sorrowful heart.

sa: अशिशुः शिशुरूपेण यावद्ब्रह्मा न बुध्यते। मया च दत्तो विप्रावय वरस्ते ब्रह्मरूपिणा॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, in the form of a boy, though I am old, stay here until Brahmana wakes up. I who am Brahma have given you boons.

sa: तमहं रथं प्राशंसमथ राजाब्रवीद् भगवता रथः प्रशस्तः। एष भगवतो रथ इति॥
en: I praised that car and then the king spoke to me thus, "O exalted one, this car has been praised by you, let this car therefore by yours.”

sa: ब्राह्मया श्रिया दीप्यमानं पिङ्गलं जटिलं कृशम्। सोऽब्रवीदर्जुनं तत्र स्थितं दृष्ट्वा महातपाः॥
en: (He was) blazing with Brahma-effulgence. With brawny colour and matted-locks, (he was) thin and lean. Seeing him (Arjuna) stopped there. The great ascetic then thus spoke to Arjuna,

sa: यः पुनर्वितथं ब्रूयाद् धर्मदर्शी सभां गतः। अनृतस्य फलं कृत्स्नं सम्प्राप्नोतीति निश्चयः॥
en: The man who knows the rules of morality and sits in an assembly, certainly incurs the sin of lie, if he answers falsely a question put to him.

sa: असतां दर्शनात् स्पर्शात् संजल्पाच्च सहासनात् धर्माचाराः प्रहीयन्ते सिद्ध्यन्ति च न मानवाः॥
en: The very sight and the touch of the sinful and conversation and association with them, cause diminution of virtue. Men (who act thus) never attain purity of soul.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुः कौरवं पुरुषोत्तमः। आमन्त्र्य प्रययौ श्रीमान् पाण्डवान् मधुसूदनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having thus spoken to the Kurus, that handsome slayer of Madhu, that foremost of men, that mighty-armed hero, saluting the Pandavas, was prepared to go away.

sa: मयूरहंसस्वननादितानि पुष्पोपकीर्णानि महाचलस्य। शृङ्गाणि सानूनि च पश्यमाना गिरेः परं हर्षमवाप्य तस्थुः॥
en: Beholding the summit and the table-land of that mighty mountain, covered with flowers and ringing with the cries of peacocks and cranes, they remained there feeling great joy.

sa: ततः परमकं ब्रह्म सा गतियोगिनां परा। आत्मा च सर्वभूतानां शुक्लो नारायणस्तदा॥
en: For this reason, even that chief refuge of all Yugas, the Supreme Brahma was attainable to all. The white cloth-wearing Narayana (also was the soul of all creatures,

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच किर्मीरस्य वधं क्षत्तः श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यताम्। रक्षसा भीमसेनस्य कथमासीत् समागमः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: O Khattva, I desire to hear (the account) of the destruction of Kirmira. Tell me how the encounter between Bhimasena and the Rakshasa (Kirmira) took place.

sa: ततो युक्तं रथं राजा समारोहत् त्वरान्वितः। अथ पर्यपतन् भूमौ जानुभिस्ते हयोत्तमाः॥
en: Then the monarch most speedily mounted the car, to which such horses had been yoked. But these best of horses fell down upon the ground on their knees.

sa: अन्धेनेव युगं नद्धं विपर्यस्तं नराधिप। कनीयांसो विवर्धन्ते ज्येष्ठा हीयन्त एव च।॥
en: O king, a yoke tied by a blind man becomes loosened. Such is the case with us. The younger ones are growing, while the elder ones are decaying.

sa: अष्टावक्र: पितरं पूजयित्वा सम्पूजितो ब्राह्मणैस्तैर्यथावत्। प्रत्याजगामाश्रममेव चावयं जित्वा सौतिं सहितो मातुलेन॥
en: Ashtavakra then worshipped his father and he himself was (also) worshipped by the Brahmanas. Having thus defeated Suta's son, he returned with his uncle to his excellent hermitage.

sa: गायत्री पठते यस्तु योनिसंकरजस्तथा। गाथा च गाथिका चापि तस्य सम्पद्यते नृप॥
en: O king, if a Brahmana whether born of a Brahmana woman or of a woman of any other caste, recites Gayitri there, his recitation becomes rhythmical and musical.

sa: आपृच्छे त्वां स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु धर्मस्त्वां परिरक्षतु। अप्रमादस्तु कर्तव्यो धर्मे धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: O foremost of all virtuous men, (now) farewell. May prosperity come to you, may virtue protect you and may you be ever steady in the practice of virtuc.

sa: कुमारश्च यथोत्पन्नो यथा चाग्नेः सुतोऽभवत्। यथा रुद्राच्च सम्भूतो गङ्गायां कृत्तिकासु च॥
en: How Kumara (Kartikeya) was born, how he came to be known as the son of Agni and how he was begotten by Rudra (Shiva) on Ganga and Krittika?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दुर्योधन कुतोमूलं भृशमार्तोऽसि पुत्रक। श्रोतव्यश्चन्मया सोऽर्थो ब्रूहि मे कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Duryodhana, O son, what is the cause of your grief? O Kuru prince, if it is fit for me to hear, tell it to me.

sa: तपश्चरंस्तु हुतभुक् संतप्तस्तस्य तेजसा। भृशं ग्लानश्च तेजस्वी न च किंचित् प्रजज्ञिवान्॥
en: Agni was then performing asceticism and he became greatly aggrieved with that effulgence. That greatly powerful deity was greatly sorry, but he did not know what to do.

sa: ततो मे पृथिवीपाल विस्मयः सुमहानभूत्। कथं त्वयं शिशुः शेते लोके नाशमुपागते॥
en: O ruler of earth, thereupon I was filled with great astonishment and (I asked myself) "how can this child alone lie here when all the world is destroyed.”

sa: ममापि वचनं सूत न शुश्रूषति मन्दभाक्। दृष्ट्वा मां चक्षुषा हीनं निर्विचेष्टमचेतसम्॥
en: O Suta, seeing me blind and incapable of taking any active steps, my wicked son considers me a fool and does not listen to what I say. are

sa: मेऽनघाः। मन्वाना देवराजं मां समाजग्मुर्विशाम्पते। दृष्ट्वा च मामपृच्छन्त किं करिष्यसि फाल्गुन॥
en: And mistaking me for the king of the gods, O lord of the earth, approached me. (But) having beheld me they asked “O Falguni, what will you do?"

sa: ॐ नमो विश्वगुप्ताय नमो विश्वपराय ते। सांनिध्यं कुरु देवेश सागरे लवणाम्भसि॥
en: “I bow to the god who protects the universe. I bow to the god who is beyond this universe. O lord of gods, come near this salt sea."

sa: नु किं विद्याबलं किं नु वरदानमथो तव। उद्योगमपि कुर्वाणो वशगोऽस्मि कृतस्त्वया॥
en: Is it my virtue of any science or by that of any boon conferred on you that you have been able to overpower me inspite of my exertions?

sa: पापात्मा भवति ह्येवं धर्मलाभं तु मे तु में शृणु। यस्त्वेतान् प्रज्ञया दोषान् पूर्वमेवानुपश्यति॥ कुशलः सुखदुःखेषु साधूंश्चाप्युपसेवते। तस्य साधुसमारम्भाद् बुद्धिर्धर्मेषु राजते॥
en: All sinful men are of this nature. Now hear about the virtuous man. He discerns evils by means of his spiritual sight. He is able to discriminate between happiness and misery. He is full of respectful attention to men of virtue; and by practising virtues, his mind becomes inclined to virtue.

sa: हनूमानुवाच यत् ते मम परिज्ञाने कौतूहलमरिदम। तत् सर्वमखिलेन त्वं शृणु पाण्डवनन्दन॥
en: Hanuman said: O chastiser of foes, as you are curious to know all about me, I shall narrate to you all. O son of Pandu, listen to it.

sa: यदि त्वं भजमानां मां प्रत्याख्यास्यसि मानद। विषमग्नि जलं रज्जुमास्थास्ये तव कारणात्॥
en: O the bestower of honor, if you forsake me who worship you, I must have recourse to either poison or fire, water or the rope for your sake."

sa: भैमीमपि नलो राजा भ्राजमनो यथा पुरा। सस्वजे स्वसुतौ चापि यथावत् प्रत्यनन्दत॥
en: King Nala, again, embraced the daughter of Bhima, who was attached to him as before; as well as he embraced his two children; and thus felt great satisfaction.

sa: हत्वा वै पुरुषो राजन् निकर्तारमरिदम्। अह्राय नरकं गच्छेत् स्वर्गेणास्य स सम्मितः॥
en: O king, O chastiser of foes, if a man goes to hell on the very day he kills his injurer, that hell at once becomes heaven to him.

sa: अयं तेषां समस्तानां शक्तः प्रतिसमासने। तान् निहत्य रणे शूरः पुनर्यास्यति मानुषान्॥
en: This one (Arjuna) also is quite competent to fight with them all. This hero, having destroyed them all in a battle, will again go back to the earth.

sa: हैरण्यौ भवतो बाहू श्रुतिर्भवति पार्थिवी। हत्वा द्विषन्तं संग्रामे भुड्क्ष्व बाहुजितं वसु॥
en: Your hand can shower gold; your fame spreads over the whole earth. Therefore, killing your enemies in battle, enjoy the wealth acquired by the strength of your arms.

sa: यथा कर्णस्य च रथो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य चोभयोः। गन्धर्वैः शतशश्छिन्नौ तथा तेषां प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: As the Gandharvas cut off the chariot of Karna and of the sons of Dhritarashtra, so they tried to do the same with respect to their (Pandava's) chariots.

sa: महार्हमाल्याभरणाः सुवस्त्राश्चन्दनोक्षिताः। मणीन् हेम च बिभ्रत्यश्चतुःषष्टिविशारदाः॥ अनुसेवां चरन्तीमाः कुशला नृत्यसामसु। स्नातकानाममात्यानां राज्ञां च मम शासनात्। एतद् राजन् मम धनं तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: And also costly garlands round their necks, who are attired in rich garments and anointed with sandal paste, who are well-skilled in sixty four elegant arts, specially in dancing and singing, and who wait upon and serve at my command the celestials, the snatakas and the kings. With this wealth, I shall (now) stake with you.

sa: नन्दां त्वभिगता देवाः : पुरा राजनिति श्रुतिः। अन्वपद्यन्त सहसा पुरुषा देवदर्शिनः॥
en: O king, tradition says that when in the days of yore the celestials came to the Nanda men suddenly appeared there with the desire of seeing the immortals.

sa: बुद्धिश्च हीयते पुंसां नीचैः सह समागमात्। मध्यमैर्मध्यतां याति श्रेष्ठतां याति चोत्तमैः॥
en: Association with the mean and the low inakes one's understanding mean and low; association with the indifferent makes it indifferent and association with the good makes it good.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्भाषमाणे तुधौम्ये कौरवनन्दन। लोमशः स महातेजा ऋषिस्तत्राजगाम ह॥ तं पाण्डवाचजो राजा सगणो ब्राह्मणाश्च ते। उपातिष्ठन्महाभागं दिवि शक्रमिवामराः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Kuru, when Dhaumya was thus talking, at that very time the greatly effulgent Rishi Lomasha came here. Thereupon the eldest Pandava, the king (Yudhishthira) with his followers and other Brahmanas sat round that greatly exalted one (Lomasha), as Shakra (Indra) is surrounded by the celestials.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गन्धर्वैस्तु महाराज भग्ने कर्णे महारथे। सम्प्राद्रवच्चमूः सर्वा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O great king, when the great car-warrior Karna was routed by the Gandharvas, the great army of Dhritarashtra's son fled away in his very sight.

sa: प्रजज्वाल ततः कोपाद् भगवान् हव्यवाहनः। तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मितो राजा जगाम शिरसावनिम्॥
en: Thereupon the illustrious carrier of sacrificial libations (Agni) blazed up in wrath. Seeing this, the king was filled with astonishment, and he bent his head to the ground.

sa: यत्र सा गोमती पुण्या रम्या देवर्षिसेविता। यज्ञभूमिश्च देवानां शामित्रं च विवस्वतः॥
en: Here flows the charming and sacred Gomati, ever adored by the celestials Rishis; here is the sacrificial ground of the celestials and the sacrificial stake of Vivasvata (sun).

sa: वैशम्पयान उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु राजानं भीमसेनमभाषत। नैतन्मनसि मे तात वर्तते कुरुसत्तम॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said to the king thus, (Kubera) spoke to Bhimasena, “O child, O the best of the Kurus, I do not (at all) mind it.

sa: दध्मौ च शङ्ख स्वनवत् सर्वप्राणेन पाण्डवः आस्फोटयच्च बलवान् भीमः संनादयन् दिशः॥
en: Then the Pandava (Bhima) sounded with all his might his loud-blowing conch. Striking his arms with his arms, the mighty Bhima made all the points of heaven resound.

sa: निर्वर्तितेषु सस्येषु यस्मै शान्तं ददौ नृपः। लोमपादो दुहितरं सावित्री सविता यथा।॥
en: When the crops were restored (by the Rishi who made Indra rain) the king Lomapada bestowed his daughter Shanta on him, as Savita (once) bestowed (his daughter) Savitri.

sa: न निर्मन्युः क्षत्रियोऽस्ति लोके निर्वचनं स्मृतम्। तदद्य त्वयि पश्यामि क्षत्रिये विपरीतवत्॥
en: This is the saying of Smriti, that in this world there is not a Kshatriya who is without anger, but in you do I behold today the contradiction.

sa: यत्र दत्तं पितृभ्योऽन्नमक्षय्यं भवति प्रभो। सा च पुण्यजला तत्र फल्गु म महानदी॥ बहुमूलफला चापि कौशिकी भरतर्षभ। विश्वामित्रोऽध्यगाद् यत्र ब्राह्मणत्वं तपोधनः॥
en: O lord, food offered here to the Pitris becomes everlasting. There flows the great river of sacred water called by the name of Falgu. O best of Bharata race, there is also in this place the Kaushika abounding in various fruits and roots where the great ascetic Vishvamitra attained to Brahmanhood.

sa: मन्त्रयेत् सह विद्वद्भिः शक्तैः कर्माणि कारयेत्। स्निग्धैश्च नीतिविन्यासान् मूर्खान् सर्वत्र वर्जयेत्॥
en: Wise men should only be consulted and affairs should be transacted only through able officer. Diplomacy must be carried on through friendly persons. Fools must always be avoided.

sa: श्रवणाच्चैव तेषां त्वं पुण्यमाप्स्यसि पाण्डव। गत्वा शतगुणं चैव तेभ्य एव नरोत्तम॥
en: O son of Pandu, only hearing of them you will acquire great merit. But going to them, O foremost of men, you will get merit hundred times greater.

sa: मातृस्तु गौरवादन्ये पितृनन्ये तु मेनिरे। दुष्करं कुरुते माता विवर्धयति या प्रजाः॥
en: Some consider the mother to be superior and some again consider the father as such. The mother, however, performs the most difficult thing; for she propagates the species.

sa: वृद्धं च भारताचार्यं तथा शारद्वतं कृपम्। आत्क्रम्य महावीर्यं किं प्रशंससि केशवम्॥
en: And also old Kripa, the son of Sharadvata, who is the preceptor of the Bharata race, passing over these greatly powerful men, why do you praise Keshava (Krishna)?

sa: बलं चातिबलो मेने न मेऽस्ति सदृशो महान्। ततः पुनरथोवाच पर्यश्रुनयनो हरिः॥ भीममाभाष्य सौहार्दाद् वाष्पगद्गदया गिरा। गच्छ वीर स्वमावासं स्मर्तव्योऽस्मि कथान्तरे॥
en: Having gained great strength, he thought that there was one equal to him in physical power. With tears in his eyes, the monkey again from affection towards Bhima thus spoke to him a choked voice, "O hero, go back to your own abode. Let me be incidentally remembered in your talk.

sa: जीवन्तमानयाचार्य मा वधी?पदात्मजा न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्य इति ते सैनिकाच ह॥
en: "O son of Drupada, bring the preceptor alive. Do not slay him. He should not be slain, he should not be slain.” Even thus did you troops also.

sa: संजय उवाच सैन्धवे निहते राजन् पुत्रस्तव सुयोधनः। अश्रुपूर्णमुखो दीनो निरुत्साहो द्विषज्जये॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, the king of Sindhu being slain, your son Suyodhana, with his eyes full of tears, became (greatly) dejected and despaired of defeating his enemies.

sa: शकुनि रभसं युद्धे कृतवैरं च भारत। माद्रीपुत्रौ च संरब्धौ शरैश्चार्दयतां भृशम्॥
en: The twin sons of Madri, Nakula and Sahadeva, inflamed with rage, O Bharata, mangled Shakuni with their shafts, in as much as the latter was their implacable enemy.

sa: के च तं वरदं वीरमन्वयुर्द्विजसत्तमम्। के चास्य पृष्ठतोऽगच्छन् वीराः शूरस्य युध्यतः॥
en: Who were they that followed the heroic bestower of boons, the foremost of the twiceborn ones? Who, O charioteer, were the warriors that remained behind that fighting hero?

sa: तस्य द्रोणो हयान् हत्वा सारथिं च महात्मनः। अथास्य सशिरस्त्राणं शिरः कायादपाहरत्॥
en: (On the other hand) Drona, having killed the horses as well as the charioteer of that highsouled one, severed his head, adorned with a diadem, from the body.

sa: तांश्च बाणहतान् वीर पश्य निष्टन्तः क्षितौ। हयांश्च पतितान् पश्य स्वर्ण भाण्डविभूषितान्॥
en: Behold! struck down on the earth by your arrows, these (elephants) are writhing in agonies. Behold! the steeds also, adorned with golden trappings, are lying on the ground.

sa: ते राक्षसाः सुसंक्रुद्धा द्रोणपुत्रेण ताडिताः। क्रुद्धाः स्म प्राद्रवन् द्रौणिं जिघांसन्तो महाबलाः॥१४८
en: Sore oppressed by the son of Drona those Rakshasas, endued with enormous strength, became mad with rage and angrily rushed against Drona's son in order to slay him.

sa: तथापि पार्थाजेष्यामि शत्तया वासवदत्तया॥ मम ह्यमोघा दत्तेयं शक्तिः शक्रेण वै द्विज।
en: Still I will vanquish the Parthas by means of the dart granted to me by Vasava. This unfailing dart was given to me, O twice-born one, by Shakra.

sa: यं पुंसां त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वशूरममंस्महि। तस्मिन् निपतिते शूरं किं शेषं पर्युपास्महे॥
en: That person, whom we looked upon as the foremost of all the heroes in the three worlds, being slain, who else there that can inspire us with confidence?

sa: सम्पूज्यमानौ समरे योधमुख्यैः सहस्रशः॥ तौ प्रबुद्धौ रणे दृष्ट्वा वने वन्यौ गजाविव।
en: (And they) were highly adored by thousands of foremost of warriors in battle. Seeing them engaged in battle like two wild elephants (encountering each other) in the forest.

sa: ततस्तु तस्मिंस्तुमुले समुत्थिते। सुदारुणे भारत मोहनीये। नोऽमुह्यत प्राप्य स राजपुत्रः। किरीटमालीव्यसृजच्छरौघान्॥
en: But, O Bharata, as that fierce stupefying and terrible battle progressed, the diademdecked Arjuna reaching the Sindhu king did not loose his senses and sped his arrows continuously.

sa: प्रियार्थं तव पुत्राणां दिक्षधुः पाण्डुनन्दनान्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तावकानां परैः सह॥
en: In order to please your son he proceeded to battle, desirous of consuming the sons of Pandu. Then commenced a terrible battle between your warriors and the foe.

sa: संजय उवाच तेषामनीकानि बृहद्ध्वजानि रणे समृद्धानि समागतानि। गर्जन्ति भेरीनिनदोन्मुखानि नादैर्यथा मेघगणास्तपान्ते॥
en: Sanjaya said All the assembled troops marshaled in array, sounding their bugles and blowing this horns, like thick volumes of clouds at the end of summer, roared thunders.

sa: एष भीमो दृढक्रोधो वृतः पार्थ समन्ततः। सृञ्जयैर्योध्यन् कर्णं पीड्यते निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Yonder, O Partha, foaming and frothing with rage yet unsatiated, fights Bhima with the Srinjaya forces around him and is getting afflicted with the sharp arrows of Karna.

sa: रक्षितश्च मया यस्मात् तस्मात् क्रुध्यसि किं मयि॥२४ यच्च मे गर्हसे राजन्नन्येन सह संगतम्। अहं त्वया विनिकृतस्तत्र मे बुद्धिविभ्रमः॥ कवचं धुन्वतस्तुभ्यं रथं चारोहतः स्वयम्। धनुर्ध्या कर्पतश्चैव युध्यतः सह शत्रुभिः॥ एवं रथगजाकीर्णे हयपत्तिसमाकुले। सिंहनादोद्धतरवे गम्भीरे सैन्यसागरे॥ स्वैः परैश्च समेतेभ्यः सात्वतेन च संगमे। एकस्यैकेन हि कथं संग्रामः सम्भविष्यति॥ बहुभिः सह संगम्य निर्जित्य च महारथान्।
en: Why do you wax wroth upon me for my having protected him, who is every way deserves my protection? You are reproaching me, O king, saying, 'When engaged with another, I have yet been incapacitated by you.' In respect to this, I submit that I committed an error in my judgment. Satyaki was shaking his armour against you and was riding on his own car, drawing his bow-string he was fighting with the foes, in the midst of his enemies abounding in steeds and foot-soldiers and teeming with cars and elephants and echoing with the war-cries of combatants. Amongst friends and foes engaged with one another, how could it be possible that the Satvata hero was engaged with one person only? Having encountered many warriors and vanquished many mighty car-warrior.

sa: नैतत्कारणमल्पं हि भविष्यति जनार्दन। तदद्य शंस मे पृष्टः सत्यं सत्यवतां वर॥
en: We also are filled with great grief, at the death of Hidimva's son, O Janardana. The cause of your delight on such occasion must indeed by very serious.

sa: आशीविष इव क्रुद्धो जुभितो मन्त्रतेजसा। तथाद्य भाति कर्णो मे शान्तज्वाल इवानलः॥
en: Karna now appears to me to be like an infuriate snake of virulent venom stupefied by the virtue of incantation or like a fire with its flames quenched.

sa: ते हि वीरा महेष्वासाः कृतास्रा दृढयोधिनः। धार्तराष्ट्रां चमूं कृत्स्नां रक्षेयुरमरा इव॥
en: They all were brave, fierce bowmen, accomplished in the use of weapons and firm in battle; and they would have then defended the Dhritarashtras like so many immortals.

sa: सोऽयं प्राप्तस्तवाक्षेपं पश्य साफल्यमात्मनः। कथं हि राजा राज्यार्थी त्वया गच्छेत संयुगम्॥६
en: He is not within your arrow-shot. Be mindful of your success. Why has king Duryodhana, desirous as he is of enjoying the kingdom come to fight with you?

sa: भूत्वा वै कौरवाः पार्थ प्रभूतगजवाजिनः। त्वां वै शत्रु समासाद्य विनष्टा रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Though the Kauravas had, at the outset, numerous steeds and elephants, yet they have been routed on the field as they had to face yourself as their foe.

sa: तव शस्त्राणि दिव्यानि लाघवं बलमेव च। असम्मोहश्च युद्धेषु विज्ञानस्य च संततिः॥ वेधः पातश्च लक्ष्येषु योगश्चैव तथार्जुन। भवान् देवान् सगन्धर्वान् हन्यात् सह चराचरान्॥२२
en: O Arjuna, you have heavenly weapons and dexterity of hand and energy; you are always clear-handed in the battle-field, well-versed in the science of war, unfailing in your aim and your ready-wit in emergencies and your martial manoeuvres are admirable. O Partha, you can vanquish the gods and Gandharvas together with the organic and inorganic creation.

sa: संजय उवाच धर्मराजस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रीतियुक्तं वचस्ततः। पार्थं प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा गोविन्दो यदुनन्दनः॥
en: Sanjaya said O majesty! Govinda, the religious soul and dignity of Yadu clan began explaining something to Arjuna in response to the vivid statement made by Dharamaraja (Yudhishthira).

sa: अद्य संयमनी याता मया त्वं निहतो रणे। यथा रामानुजेनाजौ रावणिर्लक्ष्मणेन ह॥
en: Slain by me in battle, you shall today go to the domains of the Samyamni, like the son of Ravana slain by the younger brother of Rama (Lakshmana.)

sa: कुरुसैन्याद् विमुक्तो वै सिंहो मध्याद् गवामिव। निहत्य बहुला: सेनाः पार्थेषोऽभ्येति सात्यकिः॥
en: Freed from the press of the Kaurava troops, like a lion from amidst a herd of kine, Satyaki is not approaching you, after having slain numerous hostile soldiers.

sa: तां गदां बहुभिः कर्णः सुपुङ्खः सुप्रवेजितैः। प्रत्यविध्यत् पुनश्चान्यैः सा भीमं पुनराव्रजत्॥
en: Then Karna struck that mace with numerous shafts furnished with beautiful wings and duly sped and also with other shafts. The mace then was thrown back on Bhima.

sa: स गुरुं पार्थ कस्मात् त्वं हन्तुकामोऽभिधावसि। असम्प्रघार्य धर्माणां गति सूक्ष्मा दुरत्ययाम्॥
en: Why, O Partha, do you rush upon your superior, intending to slay him, without determining (before-hand) the exceedingly fine course of virtue which is, certainly, not easily intelligible.

sa: नैष युद्धे न संग्रामे जेतुं शक्यः कथञ्चन। सधनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठो देवैरपि सवासवैः॥
en: This foremost of all wielders of bows and arrows in incapable of being vanquished in battle by any one, one excepting the gods with Vasava at their head.

sa: तस्याततं मण्डलमेव सज्यं प्रदृश्यते कार्मुकं द्रोणसूनोः। सोऽविध्यन्मां पञ्चभिर्दोणपुत्रः शितैः शरैः पञ्चभिर्वासुदेवम्॥
en: In fact, always we saw the bow of Drona's son drawn to a circle. At last he struck me with five sharp arrows and Vasudeva with another five.

sa: एषो हि पार्षतो वीरो भारद्वाजेन संगतः। घटते च यथाशक्ति भारद्वाजस्य नाशने॥
en: Yonder is the heroic son of Prisata engaged with the son of Bharadvaja; he is trying to the best of his endeavours to encompass the death of Drona.

sa: तस्य द्रोणो धनुश्छित्त्वा विद्ध्वा चैनं शिलीमुखैः। मर्माण्यभ्यहनद् भूयः स व्यथां परमामगात्॥
en: Drona however once more cut-off the prince's bow and pierced the vitals of the prince himself with large number of shafts. Thus wounded the prince was greatly pained.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे द्रौणि शं जज्वाल मारिष। यथेन्धनं महत् प्राप्य प्राज्वलद्धव्यवाहनः॥
en: Then, O sire, filled with wrath Drona's son appeared to burn on the field, like fire that blazes froth furiously having obtained heaps of fuel to feed it.

sa: अथाब्रवीदर्जुनं भीमसेनः स्ववीर्यमासाद्य कुरुप्रवीर। संशप्तकान् प्रतियोत्स्यामि संख्ये सर्वानहं याहि धनंजय त्वम्॥
en: Bhima replied then to Arjuna-"O foremost of Kurus, with the aid of my own power, I will encounter the Samsaptakas in battle, you better go yourself, O Dhananjaya.

sa: न चैतच्छक्यते ज्ञातुं कं न वध्येदिति प्रभो। अवध्यमपि हन्याद्धि तस्मान्नैतत् प्रयोजयेत्॥
en: O Lord, I know not whom it may not slay. It will even effect the death of him who is unslayable. Therefore it should not be used hastily.

sa: ततः शस्रं समुत्सृज्य निर्ममो गतचेतनः॥ आसीत् सुविह्वलो राजन् यथा दृष्टस्त्वया विभुः।
en: Thereupon the Puissant Drona, laid his weapons aside and became indifferent to every carthly concern. He was senseless and as you have seen was overwhelmed with a swoon.

sa: विलपंश्च बहु क्षत्ता शमं नालभत त्वयि। सपुत्रो भरतश्रेष्ठ तस्य भुटव फलोदयम्॥
en: Entreating you repeatedly, Khattwa failed to bend you towards peace. O foremost of the Bharatas, now do you, together with your son, suffer the consequences (of your folly).

sa: अपोवाहाथ शीघ्रं स शैनेयाद् युद्धशालिनः॥ सात्यकिस्तु रणे राजस्तावकानामनीकिनीम्। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन ततोऽनीकमभज्यत॥
en: Then that hero, expert in fighting, soon took away Sini's grandson. Then O king, Satyaki, with great force, advanced against your army at which they were all routed.

sa: तेऽपीडयन् भीमसेनं क्रुद्धाः सप्त महारथाः। प्रजासंहरणे राजन् सोमं सप्त ग्रहा इव।॥
en: Then those seven mighty car-warriors inflamed with rage, began to afflict Bhima, like the seven planets afflicting the Sun at the time of the universal annihilation, O king.

sa: तथा द्रोणो महेष्वासः पञ्चालानां रथव्रजान्। निहत्य युधि दुर्धर्षः पश्चाद् रुक्मरथो हतः॥
en: Again, after having killed the whole force of the Panchalas in battle, the mighty bowman Drona of indomitable courage, riding upon a car of gold, was slain afterwards.

sa: नित्यं प्रसक्तवैरो यः पाण्डवैः पृथिवीपतिः। विश्राव्य वैरं पार्थेन श्रुतायुः स निपातितः॥
en: That Srutayus, O king of the earth, who always entertained animosity against the Pandavas, was reminded of that animosity, before he was slain by the son of Pritha.

sa: यो बाल एव समरे सम्मितः सव्यसाचिना। केशवेन च दुर्धर्षो बलदेवेन वा विभो॥ परेषां कदनं कृत्वा महास्थविशारदः। परिवार्य महामात्रैः षड्भिः परमकै रथैः॥ अशक्नुवद्भिर्बीभत्सुमभिमन्युनिपातितः।
en: O Lord that invincible hero, Abhimanyu, who, as a boy, was like Savyasachin, Keshava and Baladeva and who also was greatly skilled in battle, was surrounded by six of the most exalted of the car-warriors and slain by them, after having made an utter extermination of the enemies, when they (warriors) became incapable of withstanding Arjuna.

sa: कचिन्नैकः परित्यक्तः पाण्डवैर्निहतो रणे। उक्तं त्वया पुरा तात यथा वीरो निपातितः॥
en: Was he not alone and forlorn, while slain by the Pandavas in battle? O son, it was told by you beforehand how the heroes my side were slain.

sa: स कथं पाण्डवं युद्धे भ्राजमानमिव श्रिया। नातरत् संयुगे पार्थ तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: How is it that Karna could not vanquish in battle that son of Pritha, of great effulgence? O Sanjaya tell me all you know about it in detail.

sa: गौतमं पञ्चविंशत्या सैन्धवं च शतेन ह॥ पुनद्रौणिं च सप्तत्या शराणां सोऽभ्यताडयत्।
en: He struck the son of Gautama with twenty five and the ruler of the Sindhus with a hundred arrows, once more he pierced Drona's son with seventy shafts.

sa: कचित् कुशालिनौ बाहू मुष्टिर्वा न व्यशीर्यत। उदीर्यमाणं हि रणे पश्यामि द्रौणिमाहवे॥
en: Has nay thing gone wrong with your arms? Has your fist sustained any injury, or how is it that I see you overwhelmed by Drouni in the field.

sa: ते कर्णमासाद्य महाप्रभावाः सुतेजना गापत्राः सुवेगाः। गात्रेषु सर्वेषु हयेषु चापि शरासने युगचक्रे ध्वजे च॥ स्ता_त्रसका भूमिमिवोरगास्ते। शराचिताङ्गो रुधिरागात्रः कर्णस्तदा रोषविवृत्तनेत्रः॥
en: Those powerful and sharp arrows, adorned with feathers like vulture quickly piercing the body, car, horses, earth and wheels of Karna, entered into the earth even as the snakes enter when afraid of Garuda; and thus being struck on all sides and bathed in blood Karna in anger rolled his eyes.

sa: स पपात तदा राजा तोमरेण समाहतः। प्रसार्य विपुलौ बाहू पीनौ परिघसंनिभौ॥
en: Then that king, having been smitten by the lance, fell upon the earth, stretching out his two long and massive arms, that resembled two iron clubs in splendour.

sa: यथा दैत्यचमं राजन देवराजो ममर्द ह। तथैव पाण्डवीं सेनां सौबलेया व्यनाशयत्॥
en: O king, the son of Subala continued to slaughter the soldiers of the Pandavas force; even as the king, of the celestials crushed the army of the Daityas.

sa: स हन्यमानः समरे गौतमेन महात्मना॥ कर्तव्यं न स्म जानाति मोहेन महताऽऽवृतः।
en: Having been thus struck in the battle by the high-souled Gautama, he (Dhristadyumna) could not make out what should he do, encompassed as he was by great insensibility.

sa: ताजित्वा समरे जिष्णुः संशप्तकगणान् बहून्॥ विरराज तदा पार्थो विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्। ४३॥
en: Then Jishnu, the son of Pritha, having defeated that immense force of Samsaptakas in the field of battle, blazed forth like the burning fire without any smoke. the

sa: ततः श्रेयस्करं यच्च तन्निबोध जनेश्वर। आयुधानां च मे वीर्यं दिव्यानामर्जुनस्य च॥
en: O lord of men, then be you conscious of what proves beneficial to you. The strength of my celestial weapons is similar to the strength of Arjuna's weapons.

sa: समयश्च हि मे वीर कश्चिद् वैकर्तनं प्रति। उत्सृजेयं यथाश्रद्धमहं वाचोऽस्य संनिधौ॥
en: But O hero, this should really be my provision towards the son of Vikartana that I will sent froth in his presence such utterances as I will desire.

sa: असुरा हि दुरात्मानः सर्व एव सुरद्विष। अपराध्यन्ति सततं ये युष्मान् पीडयन्त्युत॥
en: Indeed the Asuras are all very wickedsouled; and also they are dead against the celestials. And when they commit oppressions against you; they thus afflict me always. can

sa: स तु देवो बलेनासीत् सर्वेभ्या बलवत्तरः। महादेव इति ख्यातस्ततः प्रभृति शङ्करः॥
en: That god had really become much more powerful than all others in strength. Thereupon Shankara came to be celebrated under the title of Mahadeva from that time forward.

sa: यो यज्ञे विहितः पूर्वमीशानस्य महात्मनः। संवत्सरो धनुस्तद् वै सावित्री ज्या महास्वना॥
en: That entire year, which was formerly fixed in the sacrifice of that high-minded Ishana, now constituted the bow of the car; whereas Savitri formed the high sounding bow-string.

sa: संजय उवाच तथेति राजन् पुत्रस्ते सह कर्णेन मारिष। अब्रवीन्मद्रराजानं सर्वक्षत्रस्य संनिधौ।॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O monarch, O sire, your son, attended by Karna, addressed the king of the Madras, in the presence of all the Kshatriyas, saying-So be it.

sa: उद्वबर्ह रथाच्चापि पन्नगं गरुडो यथा। समुत्क्षिप्य च बाहुभ्यामाविध्य च पुनः पुनः॥
en: He then took the latter up from his chariot like Garuda taking up a snake. Then dragging him up with his arrows and whirling him again and again.

sa: दासीनां निष्ककण्ठीनां मागधीनां शतं तथा। प्रत्यग्रवयसां दद्यां यो मे ब्रूयाद् धनंजयम्॥
en: I will offer in gift on hundred young maids from Magadha state, well dressed and with gold garlands to the man who will tell me whereabouts of Arjuna.

sa: बालश्चन्द्रं मातुरङ्के शयानो यथा कश्चित् प्रार्थयतेऽपहर्तुम्। तद्वन्मोहाद् द्योतमान रथस्थं सम्प्रार्थयस्यर्जुनं जेतुमद्य॥
en: Like a child, on mother's lap seeking to catch hold of the sun, you, out of your folly, wish to defect the effulgent Arjuna stationed on his car.

sa: विलस्थं कृष्णसर्प त्वं बाल्यात् काष्ठेन विध्यसि। महाविषं पूर्णकोपं यत् पार्थं योद्धुमिच्छसि॥
en: By wishing to fight with Partha you are, out of folly, striking with a piece of wood the black cobra of deadly venom furiously excited within its hole.

sa: संजय उवाच राजन् संग्राममाश्चर्य तव पुत्रस्य भारत॥ एकस्य बहुभिः सार्ध शृणुष्व गदतो मम।
en: Sanjaya said The battle, O king, that was then fought, between your son on the one side and the numerous Pandavas on the other, was indeed wonderful. Hear me as I relate it.

sa: भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णो भवान् भोजश्च वीर्यवान्। शकुनिः सौबलो द्रौणिरहमेव च नो बलम्॥
en: Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karna, yourself and the most energetic king of the Bhojas as well as Shakuni, the son of Subala, the son of Drona and myself too, all had formed our army.

sa: किं कश्मलं प्राविशः पार्थ घोरम्। त्वं चात्मानं हन्तुमिच्छस्यरिघ्न नेदं सद्भिः सेवितं वै किरीटिन्॥
en: O slayer of foes, O Kiritin (Arjuna), why have you become so much crest-fallen on addressing the king as 'you.' You intend to kill yourself, but no honest man would approve of it.

sa: निपतेयं क्व नु श्रान्त इति तस्मिञ्जलार्णवे॥ अविषह्यः समुद्रो हि बहुसत्त्वगणालयः। महासत्त्वशतोद्भासी नभसोऽपि विशिष्यते॥
en: (He then thought) “where shall I alight on this vast ocean when tired?” Irrepressible is the deep the abode of numberless creatures. Inhabited by hundreds of monsters it is greater than the sky.

sa: जिघांसुभिस्तान् कुशल: शरोत्तमान् महात्वे सम्प्रहितान् प्रयत्नतः। शरैः प्राचिच्छेद स पाण्डवस्त्वरन् पराभिनद् वक्षसि चेषुभिस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Thus attacked, the son of Pandu very quickly cut-off, all the weapons sent against him by all those skillful and mighty carwarriors and struck three arrows at the breast of each of them.

sa: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनः श्रुत्वा शल्यः क्रोधसमन्वितः। विशिखां भृकुटिं कृत्वा धुन्वन् हस्तौ पुनः पुनः॥३०
en: Sanjaya said Having heard the words of Duryodhana, Shalya, who became highly enraged and who was stretching his bow to its extent and who, again, was waving his two arms often and often,

sa: ताभ्यां स सहितस्तूर्णं वीडन्निव नरेश्वरः॥ प्राप्य सेनानिवेशं त मार्गणैः क्षतविक्षतः अवतीर्णो रथातूर्णमाविशच्छयनं शुभम्॥
en: Guarded by the twins the king quickly returned to his camp in shame. His body was covered with wounds of arrows. He got down from the car and sat on his best seat.

sa: गुणवन्तं हि यो द्वेष्टि निर्गुण कुरुते प्रभुम्। स शोचति नृपः कृष्ण क्षिप्रमेवागते क्षये॥
en: O Sri Krishna! The king who keep envy within heart for meritorious and offers throne to wicked person, regrets on the consequences when these are ripen. He thus, suffers at last from agony.

sa: अविन्दमानास्त्वथ शर्म संख्ये यौधिष्ठिरं तं बलमभ्यपद्यन्। तान् प्रेक्ष्य भग्नान् विमुखोकृतांश्च घटोत्कचो रोषमतीव चक्रे॥
en: Getting no refuge, the Panchala host then fell back upon the division of Yudhishthira. Beholding these troops broken and compelled to turn away, Ghatotkacha then became excited to the highest pitch of fury.

sa: स नागराजः सह राजसूनुना पपात रक्तं बहु महेन्द्रवज्रप्रहतोऽम्बुदागमे यथा जलं गौरिकपर्वतस्तथा।॥ सर्वतः क्षरन्।
en: As the mountain made of grey chalk (Geru) starts flowing red colour water from surface when thunderbolt befallen, that elephant with blood shed body feli down dead with Kulinda Kumara rode on it.

sa: सूर्यमग्निः प्रविष्टः स्याद् यथा चाग्निं दिवाकरः। तथा प्रविष्टं तत् तेजो न प्राज्ञायत पाण्डवः॥
en: Just as the fire penetrating into the Sun or the Sun penetrating into the fire, cannot be perceived by any body so also that weapon entering into Bhima's body could not be perceived.

sa: फाल्गुनाश्च विशेषता यथा शल्याद्य कर्णोऽयं श्वेताश्वं कृष्णसारथिम्। प्रमथ्य हन्यात् कौन्तेयं तथा शीघ्रं विधीयताम्॥
en: O Shalya, even this should immediately be performed, by following which this Karna today, having crushed the son of Kunti, who possesses white horses and has Krishna for his charioteer, should slaughter him.

sa: ततः कालेन महता मेनका परमाप्सराः। पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ स्नातुं समुपचक्रमे॥ तां ददर्श महातेजा मेनकां कुशिकात्मजः। रूपेणाप्रतिमां तत्र विद्युतं जलदे यथा ॥ कन्दर्पदर्पवशगो मुनिस्तामिदमब्रवीत्। अप्सरः स्वागतं तेऽस्तु वस चेह ममाश्रमे॥
en: And, O foremost of men, it came to pass that after a long lapse of time that prime of Apsaras, Menaka, was at that time perforining her ablutions in Puskara, and she was observed by Kusika's son like to lighting among clouds. And coming under the control of Kandarpa, (Cupid) the anchorite spoke to her, saying, 'O Apsari, has your journey been a pleasant one? Do you abide in my asylum.'

sa: हरीश्च वृद्धानुपयातु साङ्गदो भवान् ममाज्ञामधिकृत्य निश्चितम्। इति व्यवस्थां हरिपुंगवेश्वरो विधाय वेश्म प्रविवेश वीर्यवान्॥
en: There is no need of scrutinizing my orders. Abiding by my order, do you see along with Angada all the elderly monkeys. having thus arranged, that best of monkeys entered the inner apartment.

sa: मन्ये भर्तुः सुखा शय्या येन बाला तपस्विनी। सुकुमारी सती दुःखं न विजानाति मैथिली॥
en: I deem that the bed of her lord appears agreeable to a wife, since a girl tender and in affliction, the chaste daughter of Mithilā experienced no inconvenience (in sleeping in one such).

sa: ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञातः सोऽप्युपाविशदासने। उपविष्टे तदा तस्मिन् साक्षाल्लोकपितामहे ॥ तद्गतेनैव मनसा वाल्मीकिानमास्थितः। पापात्मना कृतं कप्टं वैरग्रहणबुद्धिना॥ यत् तादृशं चारुरवं क्रौञ्चं हन्यादकारणात्। शोचन्नेव पुनः क्रौञ्चीमुपश्लोकमिमं जगौ।
en: Having been seated in the presence of the Grand-sire of all, Vālmīki, his mind running upon the self-same subject, became plunged in thought. What a sin has been committed by the wicked-minded one, incited by hostile feeling, that he without cause slew that sweetly-singing Kraunca! And thereupon, again lamenting that female Krauñca, he, in grief of heart, mentally recited those verses.

sa: ते पतन्ति जले नित्यं सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति। अभितप्ताः स्म सूर्येण लम्बन्ते स्म पुनः पुनः।॥
en: Day after day at sunrise, these Rākşasas heated (by solar rays) and struck dead by Brahmā energy,* again and again (hang on the crags). *The commentator explains: energy darted from the three orders.

sa: आवासा बहुभक्ष्या वै सर्वकामैरुपस्थिताः। तथा पौरजनस्यापि जनस्य बहुशोभनम्॥ दातव्यमनं विधिवत् सत्कृत्य न तु लीलया। सर्वे वर्णा यथा पूजां प्राप्नुवन्ति सुसत्कृताः॥ न चावज्ञा प्रयोक्तव्या कामक्रोधवशादपि।
en: And dwellings filled with diverse kinds of viands, and commanding everything desirable, and mansions for the lower orders of the citizens, exceedingly beautiful to behold. And meats should be duly dispensed with all hospitality, and not in the indifference of festive occasions, so that all may regard themselves as honourably entertained. And none should be disregarded out of lust or passion.

sa: आलोक्य नगरी तां च क्षयव्याकुलमानसाः। आवर्तयन्त तेऽश्रूणि नयनैः शोकपीडितैः॥ एषा रामेण नगरी रहिता नातिशोभते। आपगा गरुडेनेव हृदादुद्धृतपत्रगा॥ चन्द्रहीनमिवाकाशं तोयहीनमिवार्णवम्। अपश्यन् निहतानन्दं नगरं ते विचेतसः॥
en: Viewing the city, they with their eyes weighed down with grief, and minds oppressed with woc, shed plentiful, tears. "This city deprived of Rāma does not look beautiful, like a lake bereft of its serpent by Garuda, or the firmament deprived of the Moon, or the ocean without its waters.” And they disturbed in mind beheld the city sunk in sorrow.

sa: रामश्चिच्छेद बाणेन ध्वजं चास्य समुच्छ्रितम्। ततो हतरथात् तस्मादुत्पतन्तं निशाचरम्॥ चिच्छेद रामस्तं बाणैर्हदये सोऽभवज्जडः।
en: And Rāma with a shaft severed his upraised standard. Then as that ranger of the night was descending from his broken car, Rāma pierced his breast with arrows, and thereat he was stupified.

sa: विष्णुचक्रनिपातैश्च शतशो देवसंयुगे। अन्यैः शस्त्रैः प्रहारैश्च महायद्धेषु ताडितम्॥ अहताङ्गैः समस्तैस्तं देवप्रहरणैस्तदा। अक्षोभ्याणां समुद्राणां क्षोभणं क्षिप्रकारिणम्॥ क्षेप्तारं पर्वताग्राणं सुराणां च प्रमर्दनम्। उच्छेत्तारं च धर्माणां परदाराभिमर्शनम्॥
en: Even him who in the war of the gods had been assailed an hundred ways with the descent of Viş ņu's discus; whose body had been cut with all the weapons of the celestials; (him). who furiously disturbs the deep incapable of being disturbed; uproots mountain summits, and tramples over gods, the destroyer of righteousness, and the violator of other's wives.

sa: गतश्चाहो दिवं राजा वनस्थः स गुरुर्मम। रामं प्रतीक्षे राज्याय स हि राजा महायशाः॥
en: The king has gone to heaven, and my superior is staying in the woods. I shall remain in expectation of Rāma, assuming the reins of government. Verily that illustrious one is the king.

sa: कैकेयि मामकाङ्गानि मा स्पाक्षी: पापनिश्चये। नहि त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छामि न भार्या न च बान्धवी॥ ये च त्वामनुजीवन्ति नाहं तेषां न ते मम। केवलार्थपरां हि त्वां त्यक्तधर्मां त्यजाम्यहम्॥
en: O Kaikeyī, that have decided for following sin, do you not touch my person, nor do I wish to see you. You are no wife of mine, not even a maid-servant of a friend sharing his good graces. I am none to those that subsist on your favour, nor are they anything to me. I renounce you who solely seek your interest and have abandoned virtue.

sa: अप्येष शत्रोः शरणागतस्य दद्यात् प्राणान् धर्मचारी नृवीरः। परेह्येनं मूढ जवेन भूतये त्वमात्मनः प्राञ्जलिन्यस्तशस्त्रः॥
en: That pious, heroic man gives life even to his enemy who seeks his shelter; therefore, O fool, leaving off your weapons and with folded hands, run quickly to him for your own safety.

sa: स्वयं वैरं महत् कृत्वा पाण्डवैः सह संजयैः। युद्ध्यस्व तानन रणे पश्यामः पुरुषो भव॥
en: You have yourself sowed implacably enmity between yourself on the one side and the Pandavas and Srinjayas on the other. Let us now see you fight with them in battle. Display your manliness.

sa: नोक्तपूर्वं मया क्षुद्रम श्लीलं वा कदाचन। ऋता ब्रह्मसुता सा मे सत्या देवी सरस्वती॥
en: I have never uttered anything mean or obscene. The divine Sarasvati who is Truth, who is the daughter of Brahman and is named Rita, represents my speech and always lives in my tongue.

sa: निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥ अष्टादशपुराणानि धर्मशास्त्राणि सर्वशः। वेदाः साङ्गास्तथैकत्र भारतं चैकतः स्थितम्॥
en: He who is versed in interpretations of this great work becomes purged of every sin. Such a man lives in virtue, profit and pleasure, and acquires Liberation also, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: किमिहागमने कार्यं तव राज्यं प्रशासतः। एतदाचक्ष्व सर्वं मे न हि मे शुध्यते मनः॥
en: What is the use of your visit here, seeing that you are engaged in the task of governing the kingdom? Do you relate all this to me; my mind is ill at ease.

sa: अमोघशापैः शापस्तु दत्तोऽस्य मुनिभिः पुरा। न वेत्ता हि बलं सर्वं बली सन्नरिमर्दन ॥
en: O repressor of enemies, in the days of yore Hanumān was imprecated by the ascetics, whose curses never become fruitless, to the effect that he would never be conscious of his whole strength.

sa: तस्यायं वचनाद् दष्टो न कोपेन न काम्यया। तस्य तत्किल्बिषं लुब्ध विद्यते यदि किल्बिषम्॥
en: By his order have I bitten this child, and not out of any anger or option an my part. Therefore, if there be any sin in this, O fowler, the sin is his.

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ वाराहं तीर्थमुत्तमम्। विष्णुर्वाराहरूपेण पूर्वं यत्र स्थितोऽभवत्॥ तत्र स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठ अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्।
en: O virtuous man, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Varaha, where Vishnu formerly in his boar form lived. O foremost of men, bathing there one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma.

sa: स भवान् कुरुमध्ये तं सान्त्वपूर्वं भयोत्तरम्। ब्रूयाद् वाक्यं यथा मन्दो न व्यथेत सुयोधनः॥
en: Therefore do you in the midst of the Kurus speak words fraught with mildness, so that the foolish Suyodhana may not be struck with fear; and then (when these have failed) use threats.

sa: सीते महाकुलीनासि धर्मे च निरता सदा। इहाचरस्व धर्मं त्वं यथा मे मनसः सुखम्॥
en: Oh Sītā, you are born of an illustrious family and ever intent on the performance of religious deeds; do you practise virtue here as it may conduce to the happiness of my mind.

sa: एकहंसे नरः स्नात्वाः गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥ कृताशौचं समासाद्य तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति कृतशौतो भवेच्च सः॥
en: Bathing in Ekahansa a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine. O ruler of men, going to Kritashocha, the pilgrim obtains the lotus-eyed deity (Vishnu) and becomes pure in soul.

sa: यथा राजन् हस्तिपदे पदानि संलीयन्ते सर्वसत्त्वोद्भवानि। एवं धर्मान् राजधर्मेषु सर्वान् सर्वावस्थान् सम्प्रलीनान् निबोध॥
en: As the foot-prints of all the other animals are covered by those of the elephant, so all the duties of the other castes, under every circumstances, are covered by those of the Kshatriya.

sa: श्रिया ह्यभीक्ष्णं संवासो मोहयत्यविचक्षणम्। सा तस्य चित्तं हरति शारदाभ्रमिवानिलः॥ अथैनं रूपमानश्च धनमानश्च विन्दति।
en: Continuous Prosperity stupefies a person of weak intellect. Like the wind driving off the autumnal clouds, it drives off his judgement. Association with Prosperity induces him to think,-~-I am beautiful. I am wealthy.

sa: बदरीपाचनं गच्छेद् वसिष्ठस्याश्रमं ततः॥ बदरी भक्षयेत् तत्र त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। सम्यग् द्वादशवर्षाणि बदरी भक्षयेत् तु यः॥ त्रिरात्रोपोषितस्तेन भवेत् तुल्यो नराधिप। रुद्रमार्ग समासाद्य तीर्थसेवी नराधिप॥ अहोरात्रोपवासेन शक्रलोके महीयते।
en: O king, One should then go Badaripachana, the herinitage of Vasishtha. A man, fasting there for three nights, should eat Badari (Jujubes). He who lives on Badari for twelve years. And, O ruler of men, he who fasts there for three nights, obtains equal merits. O king, going to Rudra-marga, the pilgrim is adored in the region of Indra by fasting one day and night. to

sa: इतिहासमिमं श्रुत्वा यथावदनुपूर्वशः। संयतात्मा शुचिर्भूत्वा पारं गत्वा च भारते॥ तेषां श्राद्धानि देयानि श्रुत्वा भारत भारतम्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथाशक्त्या भक्त्या च भरतर्षभ॥ महादानानि देयानि रत्नानि विविधानि च। गावः कांस्योपदोहाच कन्याश्चैव स्वलंकृताः॥ सर्वकामगुणोपेता यानानि विविधानि च। भवनानि विचित्राणि भूमिर्वासांसि काञ्चनम्॥
en: Having with a concentrated soul and purified body, heard this history duly, from the beginning, and having reached its end, one should make Shraddha offerings, O Bharata, to them (of whom one has heard) To the Brahmanas also, O chief of Bharata's race, should, with due devotion and according to one's power, be made large gifts and various kinds of gems, and kine, and vessels of white brass for milking kine, and maidens decked with every ornament, and possessed of every accomplishment suited to the enjoyment, as also various, plots of land and cloths.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदा भगवतोऽत्यर्थमासीद् राजा महान् वसुः। किमर्थं स परिभ्रष्टो विवेश विवरं भुवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said When the great king Vasu was so wholly devoted to Narayana, why then did he drop down from heaven and why again had he to sink beneath the surface of Earth?

sa: श्वस्तु गन्तासि तं देशं वसाद्य सह मन्त्रिभिः। एतं मे कुरु सुप्राज्ञ कामं कामार्थकोविद॥
en: On the morrow you will set out for that region. Do you to-day sojourn here along with your counsellors. O wise one, do this at your pleasure, O you understanding interest and desire.

sa: स. काल: सोऽन्तको मृत्युः स यमो राज्यहानि तु। मासार्धमासा ऋतवः संध्ये संवत्सरश्च सः॥
en: He is Time, he is Destroyer, he is death, he is Yama and day and night; He is a month, a fortnight, as well as the seasons, the twilight's and the complete year.

sa: प्रजापतिसुताश्चात्र सदस्याश्चाभवंस्त्रयः। एकतश्च द्वितश्चैव त्रितश्चैव महर्षयः॥ धनुषाख्योऽथ रैभ्यश्च अर्वावसुपरावसू। ऋषिर्मेधातिथिश्चैव ताण्ड्यश्चैव महानृषिः॥ ऋषिः शान्तिर्महाभागस्तथा वेदशिराश्च यः। ऋषिश्रेष्ठश्च कपिल: शालिहोत्रपिता स्मृतः॥ आद्यः कठस्तैत्तिरिश्च वैषम्पायनपूर्वजः। कण्वोऽथ देवहोत्रश्च एते षोडश कीर्तिताः॥
en: The sons of Prajapati themselves, viz., Ekata, Dvita, and Trita became the priests watching the proceedings. There were others also who became Sadasyas in that sacrifice, viz., Dhanusha, Rajvya, Arvavasu, Paravasu, the Rishi Medhatithi, the great Rishi Tandya, the blessed Rishi Shanti, Vedashiras the foremost of Rishis, viz., Kapila, who was the father of Shalihotra, the first Kalpa, Tittiri the elder brother of Vaishampayana, Kanwa, and Devahotra, forming in all sixteen,

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दैवमेव परं मन्ये पौरुषादपि संजय। यत् सैन्यं मम पुत्रस्य पाण्डुसैन्येन बाध्यते।।।।
en: Dhritarashtra said I consider, O Sanjaya, destiny to by superior to human endeavor, in as much as, the troops of my son are always being slaughtered by those of the sons of Pandu.

sa: एते स्थाश्चातिरथाश्च तुभ्यं यथाप्रधानं नृप कीर्तिता मया। तथापरे येऽर्धरथाश्च केचित् तथैव तेषामपि कौरवेन्द्र॥
en: These are the more notable Rathas and Atirathas as has been described in due order by me to you, as also these others who are only half Rathas, O chief among the Kauravas.

sa: आर्यो युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा क्षत्रियाणां यशस्करीम्। असेवितां कापुरुषैः सेवितां पुरुषर्षभैः॥ स हि वीरोन्नतः शूरो यो भग्नेषु निवर्तते। अहो नासीत् पुमान् कश्चिद् दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं व्यवस्थितम्॥ जृम्भमाणमिव व्याघ्र प्रभिन्नमिव कुञ्जरम्। त्यजन्तमाहवे प्राणान् संनद्धं चित्रयोधिनम्॥ महेश्वासं नरव्याघ्रं द्विषतां भयवर्धनम्। कृतज्ञं सत्यनिरतं दुर्योधनहितैषिणम्॥ भारद्वाजं तथानीके दृष्ट्वा शूरूवस्थितम्। के शूराः संन्यवर्तन्त तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Alas, seeing Drona stationed in battle, like an yawning tiger or an elephant with rent temples prepared to sacrifice his life in light, clad in coat of mail, proficient in all modes of warfare, that illustrious bowman, that foremost of men, that producer of apprehensions in his enemies, grateful, devoted to truth, always desirous of doing good to Duryodhana, alas seeing him stationed at the head of his forces, did any one meet him with a praiseworthy determination for fight, determination that invests Kshatriyas with renown, that cowards cannot form and that distinguishes the foremost of men? Relate to me, O Sanjaya. Who were those heroic warriors, that encountered the son of Bharadvaja, seeing him stationed at the head of his army?

sa: सर्वेषां वै प्राणिनां कामरोषौ संत्यज्य त्वं संहरस्वेह जीवान्। एवं धर्मस्त्वां भविष्यत्यनन्तो मिथ्यावृत्तात् मानयिष्यत्यधर्मः॥
en: Renouncing both desire and anger, snatch out the lives of all living creatures. In this way you shall sccure eternal merit. Sin will destroy those who are vicious in their conduct of life.

sa: राजा च शिबिरं प्रायात् प्रणिपत्य महात्मने। शिश्ये च शयने शुभे रात्रिं तां भरतर्षभ।।२०
en: The king also retired to his own tent having bowed down to that one of illustrious soul. Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, he slept away that night on a (milk) white bed.

sa: संजय उवाच एतेनैव प्रतीतोऽहं प्रसन्नो यद्भवान् ममा प्रसन्नो यस्य भगवान् न तस्यास्तीह दुर्लभम्॥
en: Srinjaya said I am contented even with this, viz., that you, O holy sage, are pleased with me. That person with whom you are pleased, you holy one, has nothing inaccessible to him.

sa: वधे कुन्तिसुतस्याजौ नाचार्य विजयो मम। हते युधिष्ठिरे पार्था हन्युः सर्वान् हि नो ध्रुवम्॥
en: On the event of the death of the son of Kunti in battle, O preceptor, victory cannot be inine. If Yudhishthira were to be slain, Partha is sure to slay all of us.

sa: पिता त्वस्य महातेजा वृद्धोऽपि युवभिर्वरः। रणे कर्म महत् कर्ता अत्र मे नास्ति संशयः॥
en: His father, endued with great energy, is better then young persons though he is himself old and he will be the doer of great deeds in battle, of this I have no doubt.

sa: गाण्डीवघोषः स्तनयित्नुकल्पो जगाम पार्थस्य नभो दिशश्च। जग्मुश्च बाणा विमलाः प्रसन्नाः सर्वा दिशः पाण्डवचापमुक्ताः॥
en: The twang of Partha's Gandiva which resembled the roaring of thunder filled the sky and all the directions. Shot from the bow of the Pandava, bright and blazing arrows flew in all directions.

sa: ते आचार्यता मानिता मे निर्मर्यादे ह्यपि त्वयि। भूयश्च शृणु मे ब्रह्मन् सम्पदं धर्मसंग्रह।॥
en: I have shown sufficient respect to yourself as a preceptor, though you have paid little regard to me. Listen again, O Brahmana, to what should be done if you want to acquire virtue.

sa: समाहितं चात्मनि भारमीदृशं जगत् तथानित्यमिदं च लक्षये। निपातितं चाहवशौण्डमाहवे कथं नु कुर्यामहमीदृशे भयम्॥
en: This heavy burden now devolves on myself; I shall that this world is transitory. That most excellent of warriors has also fallen in battle. Why shall I then entertain any apprehension for fighting?

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते। न हि कल्याणकृत् कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति॥
en: The great one said O Partha, neither in this world, nor in the next such a man is ruined, for, O dear friend, none, who performs good deeds, comes to an evil end.

sa: कथं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो राजा त्वं वासवोपमः। पुनर्वने न दुःखी स्या इति चोद्धर्षणं कृतम्॥
en: I instilled courage into your hearts so that you who are the foremost of all righteous persons, who are equal to Vasava, might not again go into the forest and live in misery.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अब्राह्मणानां वित्तस्य स्वामी राजेति वैदिकम्। ब्राह्मणानां च ये केचिद् विकर्मस्था भवन्त्युत॥
en: Bhishma said 'The Vedas declare that the king is the master of the wealth that belongs to all persons except Brahmanas, as also of those Brahmanas who do not follow their proper duties.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच नैतत् ते साधु मघवन् यदेनमनुपृच्छसि। पृष्टस्तु नानृतं ब्रूयात् तस्माद् वक्ष्यामि ते बलिम्॥
en: Brahman said You should not, O Maghavat, thus enquire after Vali now! One should not, however, speak a falsehood when he is questioned by another. I shall tell you the whereabouts of Vali.

sa: राजोवाच यद्येवमफला सिद्धिः श्रद्धा च जपितुं तव। गच्छ विप्र मया साधु जापकं फलमाप्नुहि॥
en: If your success has become futile, and if your heart is bent upon practising again, go, O learned Brahmana, half and half with me, and you alone enjoy the reward of the recitations.

sa: क्रोधाद् यं पुरुषं पश्येस्तथा शकसमाते। स क्षिप्रं न भवेद् व्यक्तमिति त्वां वेनि कौरव॥
en: O you of effulgence equal to Shakra (Indra), that person on whom you cast a look of anger, surely meets with death for it has been seen and so I know, O Kaurava.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कन्यायाः प्राप्तशुल्कायाः पतिश्चेन्नास्ति कश्चन। तत्र का प्रतिपत्तिः स्यात् तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said If a person, after having given dower for a maiden, goes away, how should the maiden's father or other kinsmen who can bestow her, act? Do tell me this, O grandfather?

sa: न कर्मणा साधुनैकेन नूनं सुखं शक्यं वै भवतीह संजय। न शक्नुमो धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रम्॥
en: It is not by a single good deed that we can be happy in this world, O Sanjaya, when with all our endeavors are we unable to win over the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं स्वयं तथैव च। कृष्णद्वैपायनेनेदं कृतं पुण्यचिकीर्षुणा॥ कीर्ति प्रथयता लोके पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। अन्येषां क्षत्रियाणां च भूरिद्रविणतेजसाम्॥ सर्वविद्यावदातानां लोके प्रथितकर्मणाम्। य इदं मानवो लोके पुण्यार्थे ब्राह्मणाञ्छुचीन्॥ श्रावयेत महापुण्यं तस्य धर्मः सनातनः। कुरूणां प्रथितं वंशं कीर्तयन्सततं शुचिः॥
en: In order to extend the fame of the highsouled Pandavas and other Kshatriyas, learned in all branches of knowledge, high-spirited and already famous in the world for their great deeds, Krishna Dvaipayana, moved by the desire of benefiting the world, has composed this excellent, sacred and big work which spreads one's fame and gives one a long life. He who, from the desire of acquiring virtue, causes this history to be heard in this world by holy Brahmanas, gains inexhaustible virtue. He who recites the history of the Kurus, becomes immediately pure and holy.

sa: सा कामरूपिणी रूपं कृत्वा मानुषमुत्तमम्। उपतस्थे महाबाहुं भीमसेनं शनैः शनैः॥ लज्जमानेव ललना दिव्याभरणभूषिता। स्मितपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं भीमसेनमथाब्रवीत्॥ कुतस्त्वमसि सम्प्राप्तः कश्चासि पुरुषर्षभ। क इमे शेरते चेह पुरुषा देवरूपिणः॥
en: She was capable of assuming any from at will. She assumed an excellent human form and came slowly to the mighty armed Bhimasena. Being decked with celestial ornaments, she came to Bhimasena in bashfui demeanour and with smiles on her lips. She said, "O best of men, whence have you come her and who are you? Who are these celestial like men that are asleep here?

sa: दहत्क्वचिज्ज्वलन इवावलेलिहत् प्रसह्य तानसुरगणान्यकृन्तत। प्रवेरितं वियति मुहुः क्षितौ तथा पपौ रणे रुधिरमथो पिशाचवत्॥
en: Sometimes it blazed like fire and consumed them all; sometimes it struck them down like a goblin; sometimes it drank the blood of the slain Danavas as it travelled through earth and sky.

sa: शममेव परं मन्ये शमात् क्षेमं भवेन्मम। आरम्भे पारमेष्ठ्ये तु न प्राप्यमिति मे मतिः॥
en: I consider peace of mind as the highest quality, for from peace of mind proceeds prosperity. In my opinion, if I undertake to perform this sacrifice, I shall not win the highest reward.

sa: स्तथा परं तुल्यसंख्यं शतं वै। तथा यज्ञोऽयं तव भारताग्र्य पारिक्षित स्वस्ति नोऽस्तु प्रियेभ्यः॥
en: O son of Parikshit, О best of the Bharata race, Indra performed one hundred sacrifices, but your sacrifices, is fully equal to his sacrifice. Blessings be upon those who are dear to us!

sa: ततस्तु ते तद्गृहग्निना वृतं प्रदीप्यमानं विषजेन भोगिनः। भयात्परित्यज्य दिश: प्रपेदिरे पपात राजाऽशनिताडितो यथा॥
en: The palace, in which the king was living, blazed up with the poison of the snake. The ministers left it and fled in fear and the king fell down if struck by lightning.

sa: एवमुक्ते तु गृध्रेण उलूको वाक्यमब्रवीत्। सोमाच्छतक्रतोः सूर्याद्धनदाद्वा यमात्तथा॥ जायते वै नृपो राम किंचिद्भवति मानुषः। त्वं त सर्वमयो देवो नारायण इवापरः॥ याचते सौम्यता राजन्सम्यकप्रणिहिता विभो। समं चरसि चान्विष्य तेन सोमांशको भवान्॥ क्रोधे दण्डे प्रजानाथ दाने पापभयापहः। दाता हर्तासि गोप्तासि तेनेन्द्र इव नो भवान्॥ अधृष्यः सर्वभूतेषु तेजसा चानलोपमः। अभीक्ष्णं तपसे लोकांस्तेन भास्करसंनिमः॥
en: The vulture having said this, the owl began:"True, it is, o king, that is him are the portions of the Moon, Indra, the Sun, Kubera and Yama, but there is in him also a portion of man. But you are yourself the omnipresent deity, Narayana. You, impelled by your own self, do judge all creatures impartially; therefore, a portion of gentleness is well manifest in you and therefore do people call you, a portion of the Moon. O patriarch, in anger, punishment, gift with and fear, you are our giver, destroyer and protector,-it is for this that you are called Indra. in energy you are like fire irrepressible to all creatures, and because you do spread your lustre upon all creatures that you are called the Sun.

sa: ययातिरुवाच पूरो प्रीतोऽस्मि ते वत्स प्रतिश्चेदं ददामि ते। सर्वकामसमृद्धा ते प्रजा राज्ये भविष्यति॥
en: Yayati said : O Puru, my child, I am much pleased with you. I grant you the following boon with great pleasure. "The people of your kingdom will have all their desires fulfilled."

sa: वैवस्वतस्यैव तनुर्विभक्ता वीर्येण युष्माकमुत प्रयुक्ता। सैषामन्तो भविता ह्यन्तकाले न तत्र वीर्यं भविता नरेषु॥
en: When that time will come, the son of Vivasvata will be strengthened by your respective energies. He will then sweep away thousands of human beings who will have no energy left in them.

sa: कच उवाच पूज्यो मान्यश्च भगवान् यथा तव पिता मम। तथा त्वमनवद्याङ्गि पूजनीयतरा मम॥
en: Kacha said: You are an object of my respect and worship, as is your illustrious father. O lady of faultless features, you are an object of greater reverence to me (than your father).

sa: तस्मान्न तापं दुहितुर्निमित्तं पाञ्चालराजोऽर्हति कर्तुमद्या न चापि तत्पातनमन्यथेह कर्तुं हि शक्यं भुवि मानवेन॥
en: It is, therefore, not proper for the Panchala king to grieve today for his daughter. There is no man in the world who can (now) undo that act of shooting down the mark.

sa: आख्यात च ज्ञातिकुलानुपूर्वी पदं शिरस्सु द्विषतां कुरुध्वम्। प्रह्लादयध्वं हृदयं ममेदं पाञ्चालराजस्य च सानुगस्य॥
en: Giving us all particulars of your family and tribe, place your feet on the heads of your enemies and gladden the hearts of the Panchala king and his men and of mine also.

sa: अपि धर्मेण वर्तेध्वं शास्त्रेण च परंतपाः। अपि विप्रेषु पूजा वः पूजार्हेषु न हीयते॥
en: Vyasa said : "O chastisers of foes, are you following the path of virtue and scriptures? Do you worship the Brahmanas? You are not deficient in giving homage to those that deserve homage."

sa: पशून् वासांसि रत्नानि धनानि विविधानि च। पाण्डोः प्रयच्छ मात्र्याश्च येभ्यो यावच्च वाञ्छितम्।२।। यथा च कुन्ती सत्कारं कुर्यान्मात्र्यास्तथा कुरु। यथा न वायुर्नादित्यः पश्येतां तां सुसंवृताम्॥
en: For the good of their souls, distribute cattle, cloths, gems and all kinds of wealth and give every one as much as he asks. Make arrangements also for Kunti's performance of the last rites of Madri in such a way as will please her. Let Madri's body be so carefully covered that neither the sun nor the wind may see it.

sa: शक्तस्त्वमात्मनात्मानं विनेतुं मनसा मनः। लोकान्सर्वांश्च काकुत्स्थ किं पुनः शोकमात्मनः॥ नेदृशेषु विमुह्यन्ति त्वद्विधाः पुरुषर्षभाः।
en: O Kakutstha, While you can control yourself and your mind, should you not be able to bear this trifling pain of separation? Leading men like yourself are never overwhelmed by all these things.

sa: गमनं चाप युक्तं स्याद् दृढमेषां महात्मनाम्। न तु तावन्मया युक्तमेतद् वक्तुं स्वयं गिरा।॥ यदा तु मन्यते वीरः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। भीमसेनार्जुनो चैव यमौ च पुरुषर्षभौ॥ रामकृष्णौ च धर्मज्ञो तदा गच्छन्तु पाण्डवाः। एतौ हि पुरुषव्याघ्रावेषां प्रियहिते रतौ॥
en: It is highly proper for these illustrious princess to return to their ancestral kingdom. But it is not proper for me to say this myself. If the hero, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, if Bhima and Arjuna, if these best of men the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) and if Rama and Krishna, both learned in the precepts of religion, wish it, then let the Pandavas go there. These two best of men (Rama and Krishna) are ever engaged in doing what is agreeable and beneficial to them (the Pandavas).

sa: यदाश्रौषं विविधास्तत्र चेष्टा धर्मात्मानां प्रस्थितानां वनाय। ज्येष्ठप्रीत्या क्लिश्यतां पाण्डवानां तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the four Pandava brothers, weeping in sorrow, had followed their eldest brother and had tried every means to mitigate his discomfort.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच धनंजय निबोधेदं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। वसिष्ठं प्रति दुर्धर्ष तथा मित्रसहं नृपम्॥
en: The Gandharva said : O Dhananjaya, O irrepressible hero, listen to me as I answer the question you have asked me in respect of Vasishtha and that chastiser of foes the king (Kalmashapada).

sa: तथा चेदं ददाम्यद्य नियमेन सुतोषितः। विशेषं तव कल्याणि प्रयच्छामि वरं वरे॥ अरुन्धत्या वरस्तस्या यो दत्तो वै महात्मना। तस्य चाहं प्रभावेण तव कल्याणि तेजसा॥ प्रवक्ष्यामि परं भूयो वरमत्र यथाविधि। यस्त्वेका रजनी तीर्थे वत्स्यते सुसमाहितः॥ स स्नात्वा प्राप्स्यते लोकान् देहन्यासात् सुदुर्लभान्।
en: O amiable maiden, you have practised severer penances. Gratified with your vows, I shall also grant you this especial boon, O auspicious one, a boon that is superior to what was granted to Arundhati. Through the power of the great god who had granted that boon to Arundhati and through your own energy, O amiable one, I shall duly grant you another boon now, viz., that the person who will live in this Tirtha for only one night and bathe here with his mind concentrated, will, after renouncing his body, obtain many blissful regions that are difficult of acquisition.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ गान्धारे मां योधय सुयोधन। एक एकेन संगम्य संयुगे गदया बली।॥
en: Yudhishthira said Rise, rise, O son of Gandhari and fight me, O Suyodhana. Alone as you are fight us, meeting one at a time, O you of great might, armed with your mace.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि नीतिमापत्सु भारत। उत्सृज्यापि घृणां काले यथा वर्तेत भूमिपः॥
en: Bhishma said 'I shall tell you, O Bharata, the policy the king should pursue amid such distress. I shall tell you how he should behave himself at such a time, casting off mercy.

sa: अयं हि कालोऽस्य दुरात्मनो वै पार्थस्य वैरप्रतियातनाय। संचिन्त्य तूणं प्रविवेश चैव कर्णस्य राजशररूपधारी॥
en: And believing, O monarch, this to be the just time for avenging himself upon the wicked (in his opinion) Partha he summed the shape of an arrows and entered quickly into Karna's quiver.

sa: पशुलुब्धौ युवां यस्मान्मामुत्सृज्य प्रधावितौ॥ तस्माद् वृकाकृती रौद्रौ दंष्ट्रिणावभितश्चरौ। भवितारौ मया शप्तौ पापेनानेन कर्मणा॥
en: Since, actuated by covetousness, you ran away, leaving me, therefore, you shall become dreadful wolves with sharp teeth and range the forest cursed by me on account of that sinful act of yours.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच चातुराश्रम्यमुक्तं ते चातुर्वर्यं तथैव च। राष्ट्रस्य यत् कृत्यतमं ततो ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have described what the duties are of the four modes of life and of the four orders. Tell me now, O grandfather, what are the principal duties of a kingdom.'

sa: भीमसेनस्तु तान् दृष्ट्वा नागान् मत्तगजोपमः। करेणादाय महतीं गदामभ्यपतद् बली॥ अथाप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः।
en: The powerful Bhimasena, himself like an infuriate elephant, seeing those elephants, took up his formidable mace and rushed at them, quickly jumping down from his car, like the Destroyer armed with his club.

sa: वार्धकेन च राजेन्द्र तपसा चैव कर्शिता। सा नाशकद् यदा गन्तुं पदात् पदमपि स्वयम्॥
en: At last when she became very old and physically incapable to move even a single step without being helped by any one, she made up her mind to depart to the other world.

sa: नास्ति युद्धे कृती कश्चिन्न विद्वान् न पराक्रमी। यत्र शान्तनवो भीष्मः शेतेऽद्य निहतः शरैः॥
en: When Shantanu's son lies to-day, struck down with arrows, it seems that no other person alive on Earth who is learned and powerful and who is competent to perform great feats in battle.

sa: यस्यां भवन्ति भूतानि तद् विद्धि मनुजर्षभ। एष एव परो धर्मो यद् राजा दण्डनीतिमान्॥
en: Know, O foremost of men, that the very lives of creatures depend upon it. The greatest merit of a king consists in his acquaintance with the science of punishment and administering it properly.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सांख्याः सांख्यं प्रशंसन्ति योगा योगं द्विजातयः। वदन्ति कारणं श्रेष्ठं स्वपक्षोद्भावनाय व॥
en: Bhishma said The followers of Sankhya praise the Sankhya system and the Yogins praise the Yoga system. For fixing the superiority of their respective systems, each calls his own system to be better.

sa: हित्वा हित्वा ह्ययं प्रैति देहाद् देहं कृताश्रयः। कालसंचोदितः क्षेत्री विशीर्णाद् वा गृहाद् गृहम्॥
en: His habitation always resulting from nescience, desire, and acts, he migrates from body to body, leaving off one after another repeatedly, urged on by Time, like a person leaving house after in succession.

sa: सस्त्रीकुमारं च पुरं बभूवास्वस्थमानसम्। अथाब्रवीन्नृपः पुत्रं पापोऽयं वध्यतामिति॥ अस्य मांसैरिमे सर्वे विहरन्तु यथेष्टतः।
en: The entire city of the Rakshasa king,-men, women, and children,-was plunged in grief. The king then ordered his son, saying,-Let this sinful wretch be killed! Let these Rakshasas here eai merrily his flesh.

sa: किं कत्थसे मां किं च त्वं कालेन निरपत्रपः। वेत्थ यत् तदा पौरुषं मम॥
en: Why then do you brag thus before me, forgetting, O shameless one, that it is Time that has made you what you are? You yourself saw what my prowess was in those days.

sa: राजोवाच राजाहं ब्राह्मणश्च त्वं यदा षट्कर्मसंस्थितः। ददानि वसु किंचित्ते प्रथितं तद् वदस्व मे॥
en: The king said I am a king. You are a Brahmana observing the six well-known duties. I will give you some wealth. That is well-known. Tell me how much I shall give you.

sa: न ह्यस्त्यविदितं लोके देवर्षे तव किंचन। श्रुतं वाप्यनुभूतं वा दृष्टं वा कथयस्व मे॥
en: O celestial Rishi, there is nothing in the universe which you do not know. Do you tell me, therefore, of any wonderful event which you may have seen, or heard of, or felt.

sa: तस्माद् वरमहं काइक्षे निधनं वाऽपि कौशिक। गच्छ वा तिष्ठ वा शक्र यथेष्टं बलसूदन॥
en: It is from Mahadeva that I wish to get boons. Not getting this, O Kaushika, I would rather prefer dissolution itself. Go or remain, O Shakra, as you like, O slayer of Vala.

sa: यस्य भार्या गृहे नास्ति साध्वी च प्रियवादिनी। अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं यथारण्यं तथा गृहम्॥
en: He who has not in his house a wife, chaste and of sweet speech, should go to the forest. For such a one there is no difference between a home and a forest.

sa: तद् धिया ध्यायति ब्रह्म जपन् वै संहिताम् हिताम्। संन्यस्यत्यथवा तां वै समाधौ पर्यवस्थितः।१६॥
en: He should, reciting the highly beneficial verse (viz., the Gayatri), meditate with the help of his intellect on Brahma alone. Afterwards he should even leave off that, being then absolutely immersed in contemplation.

sa: त्यजतां जीवितं श्रेयो निवृत्ते पुण्यपापके। यत्त्वेव राज्ञो ज्यायिष्ठं कार्याणां तद् ब्रवीमि ते ॥
en: Of all creatures, they are superior who have betaken themselves to renunciation and abstained from acts both meritorious and sinful, I shall now tell you those acts which are best for a king.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तस्मै प्रोवाच तत् सर्वं पिता पुत्राय पृच्छते। अतीतानागते विद्वान् सर्वज्ञः सर्वधर्मवित्॥
en: Bhishma said The father, having a knowledge of both the past and the future, conversant with all duties and gifted with omniscience, thus described the subject to his son, who had questioned him.

sa: योगीश्वराः सुबहवो योगदं पितरं गुरुम्। ब्रह्मर्षयश्च ससुतास्तथा देवर्षयश्च वै॥ पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च नक्षत्राणि ग्रहास्तथा। मासार्धमासा ऋतवो रात्रिः संवत्सराः क्षणाः।।३९४ मुहूर्ताश्च निमेषाश्च तथैव युगपर्ययाः। दिव्या राजन् नमस्यन्ति विद्याः सत्त्वविदस्तथा।।३९५
en: Numberless masters of Yoga, all the twiceborn Rishis with their children, all the celestial Rishis, the goddess Earth, the Sky, the Constellations, the Planets, the Months, the Fortnights, the Seasons, Night, the Years, the Kshanas, the Muhurtas, the Nimeshas, the Yugas one after another, all the celestial Sciences and branches of knowledge, all beings conversant with Truth, were seen bowing down that Supreme Preceptor, that great Father, that giver of Yoga.

sa: अचिन्त्य एष भगवान् कर्मणा मनसा गिरा। न मे तात युधिश्रेष्ठ विद्यया पण्डितः समः॥
en: That illustrious god is incapable of being comprehended in thought, word, or deed. O son, O you who are the best of warriors, there is none who is equal to me in learning.

sa: प्रत्यादित्यं न मेहेत न पश्येदात्मनः शकृत्। सह स्त्रियाथ शयनं सह भोज्यं च वर्जयेत्॥
en: One should not pass urine with face turned towards the Sun, nor should one see his own excreta. One should not lie on the same bed with a woman, nor eat with her.

sa: अनन्तमिव मे वित्तं यस्य मे नास्ति किञ्चन। मिथिलायां प्रदीप्तायां न मे दह्यति किञ्चन॥
en: What the monarch said was,-My wealth is unlimited, At the same time I have nothing. If the whole of (my kingdom) Mithila be reduced to ashes in a conflagration, I shall lose nothing.

sa: अचोद्यमानानि यथा पुष्पाणि च फलानि च। स्वं कालं नातिवर्तन्ते तथा कर्म पुरा कृतम्॥
en: As flowers and fruits, without being compelled, never allow their proper time to pass away without making their appearance, so the acts one has done in past life appear at the proper time.

sa: श्रुतं ते न श्रुत मन्ये मृषा वापि श्रुतं श्रुतम्। अथवा श्रुतसंकाशं श्रुतमन्यच्छ्रुतं त्वया॥
en: I think that you have not listened to the scriptures, or, you have listened to them without any advantage, or, perhaps, you have listened to some other books loO king like the scriptures.

sa: अष्टवक्र उवाच हरन्ति दोषजातानि नरं जातं यथेच्छकम्। प्रभवामि सदा धृत्या भद्रे स्वशयनं व्रज॥
en: Ashtavakra said Various shortcomings drag away the man who acts as he likes. As for myself I am able to govern my inclinations by selfcontrol. O good lady, return to your own bed.

sa: एवं दृष्टो मया कृष्ण देवदेवः समाधिना। तदवाप्तं च मे सर्वं यदुक्तं तेन धीमता॥
en: It was even, O Krishna, that I saw, with the help of austere penances, that God of gods. I also got all that was said by the great God endued with supreme intelligence.

sa: इत्येतत् सर्वदेवानां चातुर्वर्ण्य प्रकीर्तितम्। एतान् वै प्रातरुत्थाय देवान् यस्तु प्रकीर्तयेत्॥ स्वजादन्यकृताच्चैव सर्वपापात् प्रमुच्यते। यवक्रीतोऽथ रैभ्यश्च अर्वावसुपरावसू॥ औशिजश्चैव कक्षीवान् बलश्चाङ्गिरसः सुताः। ऋषिर्मेधातिथेः पुत्रः कण्वो बर्हिषदस्तथा॥ त्रैलोक्यभावनास्तात प्राच्यां सप्तपर्यस्तथा। उन्मुचो विमुचश्चैव स्वस्त्यात्रेयश्च वीर्यवान्॥ प्रमुचश्चेध्यवाहश्च भगवांश्च दृढव्रतः। मित्रावरुणयोः पुत्रस्तथागस्त्यः प्रतापवान्॥ एते ब्रह्मर्षयो नित्यमास्थिता दक्षिणां दिशम्। कवषो धौम्यः परिव्याध
en: Thus have I told you about the fourfold order among the gods. The person who, after rising from his bed in the morning, recites the names of these deities, becomes purged off of all his sins-whether committed by himself intentionally or unintentionally, or whether born of his intercourse with others. Yavakrita, Raivya, Arvavasu, Paravasu, Ausija, Kakshivat, and Vala, are described as the sons of Angiras. These and Kanwa son of the Rishi Medhatithi, and Varhishada, and the wellknown seven Rishis who are the progenitors of the three worlds, all live in the East. Unmucha, Vimucha, the highly energetic Sastyatreya, Pramucha, Idhmavaha, and the divine Dridavrata, and Mitravaruna's highly energetic son Agastya, these twice-born Rishis all live in the South Ushanga, Karusha, Dhaumya, Parivyadha o

sa: इह चिन्ता बहुविधा धर्माधर्मस्य कर्मणः। कर्मभूमिरियं लोके इह कृत्वा शुभाशुभम्। शुभैः शुभमवाप्नोति तथाशुभमथान्यथा॥
en: Here there is much thought about fair and sinful acts. This region where we live is the field of action. One reaps the fruits of his actions, according to thelife he has led.

sa: न कार्यमिह मे नाथ जीवितेन त्वया विना॥ पतिहीना तु का नारी सती जीवितुमुत्सहेत्।
en: Useless is life to me, O lord, now that I am separated from you! What chaste woman is there who would, when bereft of her husband, venture to bear the burden of life.

sa: भीष्म उवाच करोति पापं योऽज्ञानानात्मनो वेत्ति च क्षयम्। प्रद्वेष्टि साधुवृत्तांश्च स लोकस्यैति वाच्यताम्॥
en: Bhishma said The person who commits sin out of ignorance, who does not know that his end is near, and who always hates persons of good conduct, soon incurs infamy in the world.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इत्युक्त्वा बहुशो विद्वान् चामं भक्ष्याय संश्रितः। चामे शुचीनि प्रचरन् कुलानि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Markandeya said : Having uttered these words several times, the educated Brahmana entered a village for alms and foremost of the Bharata race, after having gone round the sacred families in the village.

sa: राज्ये तदा तत्र गत्वा स विप्रः प्रोवाचेदं वचनं वामदेवः। मेवं राजन् सर्वधर्मेषु दृष्टम्॥
en: Then the Brahmana Vamadeva went to his kingdom and spoke thus to the king Dala, “O king, it has been ordained in all the Shastras that men should give away to the Brahmanas.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच अग्नीनां विविधा वंशाः कीर्तितास्ते मयानघ। शृणु जन्म तु कौरव्य कार्तिकेयस्य धीमतः॥
en: Markandeya said : O sinless one, O descendant of Kuru, I have told you the history of the various branches of the Agni race. (Now) hear about the birth of the intelligent Kartikeya.

sa: यथा प्रविश्यान्तरमन्तकस्य काले मनुष्यो न विनिष्क्रमेता तथा प्रविश्यान्तरमस्य संख्ये को नाम जीवन् पुनराव्रजेत्॥
en: As men coming within the clutches of death can never come out of it, so who is there that once coming under his clutches in the field of battle, escapes with his life.

sa: विपाप्मानो महात्मानो विप्रेभ्यः प्रददुर्वसु। तपस्विजनजुष्टां च ततो वेदी प्रजापतेः॥ जग्मुः पाण्डुसुता राजन् ब्राह्मणैः सह भारत। तत्र ते न्यवसन् वीरास्तपश्चातस्थुरुत्तमम्॥ संतर्पयन्तः सततं वन्येन हविषा द्विजान्।
en: Having been thus cleansed of all their sins, those high-souled heroes gave much wealth to the Brahmanas. O descendant of Bharata, then the son of king, O Pandu went to the (sacrificial altar) Vedi of the Creator, ever adored by the ascetics. There lived those heroes and performed excellent asceticism. Always gratifying the Brahmanas with the offer of fruits and ghee.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच कथं सम्भवते योनौ कथं वा पुण्यपापयोः। जातीः पुण्यास्त्वपुण्याश्च कथं गच्छति सत्तम॥
en: The Brahmana said: Why does the soul take its birth and how does it become sinful or virtuous? O excellent one, how does it come to belong to a sinful or virtuous man?
